mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP3A4, which may increase bumetanide metabolism and reduce its diuretic efficacy; additionally, both drugs can cause hyponatremia and carbamazepine may increase electrolyte depletion risk.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (sodium, potassium), fluid balance, and diuretic response; consider dosage adjustment of bumetanide if diuretic effect diminishes; assess for signs of hyponatremia or hypokalemia.
